title: Software Firmware Architect
description: Shape the future of connected vehicle technology At Teletrac Navman, we help businesses improve productivity, safety and sustainability through innovative fleet management and telematics solutions. We're looking for an experienced Software Firmware Architect to play a key role in designing and evolving the embedded firmware architecture that powers our next generation products. This is a senior technical leadership position where you'll influence product strategy, drive architecture decisions, mentor engineers, and help deliver secure, scalable and reliable embedded solutions used by customers around the world. About The Role Reporting to the CTO, you will take ownership of firmware architecture across our embedded product portfolio and work closely with engineering, validation, product management and key stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions. Key responsibilities include: Define and evolve the long-term firmware architecture strategy Design robust, secure and maintainable embedded software solutions Lead architecture, design and code reviews across firmware teams Promote best practices, standards and architectural patterns Collaborate with product and validation teams to ensure quality outcomes Evaluate and integrate new technologies into existing platforms Contribute to product definition and technical roadmaps Mentor and coach engineers across the firmware team Drive continuous improvement in development processes and technology adoption To be successful in this role, you'll bring: Tertiary qualification in Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience 10+ years of embedded firmware development experience using C Proven experience architecting embedded systems and products Strong understanding of software design principles, patterns and best practices Experience working within Agile development environments Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills Ability to influence technical direction and communicate complex concepts clearly Passion for mentoring and developing engineering talent A collaborative approach and ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders Strong written and verbal communication skills Why Join Teletrac Navman? Work on globally deployed connected technology solutions Influence the architecture of next-generation embedded products Join a collaborative and innovative engineering culture Competitive remuneration and benefits package Modern Rosedale office location Opportunities for professional growth and technical leadership At Teletrac Navman We value innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement. If you're passionate about embedded systems and want to help shape the future of our technology platforms, we'd love to hear from you. Who Is Teletrac Navman Teletrac Navman’s goal is to empower the industries that transform and sustain our futures with simple and intelligent solutions that enhance the efficiency, safety, and sustainability of their operation. As a connected mobility platform for industries that manage vehicle and equipment assets, Teletrac Navman simplifies the complex so that its customers can transform the way they work through cloud-based solutions that leverage AI to unlock the power of operational insight. Teletrac Navman manages more than 700,000 vehicles and assets around the world. The company operates globally, with offices worldwide and headquarters in Northbrook IL.
